body.name: \mathcal R_{1-\eta}
body.def: \(\mathcal R_{1-\eta}\) is the Cartesian product of \([\widehat\mu_e-\rho_{h(e)},\widehat\mu_e+\rho_{h(e)}]\cap[\underline y,\overline y]\) and \([\widehat\nu_j-\rho_{g_j},\widehat\nu_j+\rho_{g_j}]\cap[\underline y,\overline y]\), using \([\underline y,\overline y]\) when the relevant cohort count is zero.
